She is first seen at the [[Kalos Power Plant]] with one of the {{tc|Team Flare Admin}}s. Although she's defeated, she declares their operation of stealing energy from the plant a success and leaves. {{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Aliana anime.png|thumb|250px|Aliana in {{aniseries|XY}}]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== In the past, Aliana, alongside [[Lysandre]] and the other [[Team Flare]] Scientists, would help those in need, until Lysandre became disillusioned with the [[human]] race and sought to restart the world. Aliana debuted in ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]''. She was seen at [[Lysandre Labs]] with [[Bryony]] when [[Xerosic]] informed that she would be tasked with capturing {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|50%}} {{p|Zygarde}}, which [[Mable]] had recently failed to accomplish. [[File:Team Flare Scientists Young.png|thumb|left|250px|A younger Aliana (right)]] Aliana briefly appeared in ''[[XY102|Meeting at Terminus Cave!]]'' in a video call with Xerosic, where she and Mable got ordered to head to [[Z2]] after Team Flare found out its location thanks to their sensors. In ''[[XY107|An Explosive Operation!]]'', she, Mable, and several {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s were trying to capture Z2. When she and Mable ordered their Pokémon, {{p|Druddigon}} and {{p|Weavile}}, to attack Z2, it transformed into its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|10% Forme}} and used its powerful attacks to blow Team Flare away and managed to escape. She and Mable quickly managed to catch up to it, only to face {{TRT}}, who wanted Z2 for themselves. Thanks to Team Rocket, Z2 managed to escape once again. Team Flare, however, quickly found them and a battle between both took place. After a prolonged struggle, Team Flare emerged victorious and managed to corner Z2. This, however, triggered Z2 to transform to its 50% Forme and easily blew Aliana and the others back. As Z2 was about to finish them off, [[Alain]] and his {{TP|Alain|Charizard}} interfered and battled Z2 to buy her and Mable time. While Z2 was battling, she and Mable surprised it by shooting it with their laser guns, finally bringing it down and captured it, completing their mission. In ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', during Team Flare's attack on [[Lumiose City]], Aliana was guarding the [[Prism Tower]] with Bryony and used her Druddigon to prevent {{an|Serena}}, {{an|Clemont}}, {{an|Bonnie}}, [[Clembot]], and [[Meyer|Blaziken Mask]] from entering. In [[XY133|the following episode]], she and Bryony battled Clemont, Clembot, and Blaziken Mask, but both ended up getting defeated and were captured, allowing Clemont and Clembot to enter Prism Tower. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Aliana |pkmn=Druddigon |type1=Dragon |img=Aliana Druddigon.png |epnum=XY107 |epname=An Explosive Operation! |vaen=Billy Bob Thompson |desc={{p|Druddigon}} is Aliana's only known Pokémon. It first appeared in ''[[XY107|An Explosive Operation!]]'', where it was seen attacking [[Z2|Zygarde]] alongside [[Mable]]'s {{p|Weavile}}. When Z2 transformed to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|10% Forme}}, it was easily beaten back. It was later used twice against {{TRT}} to try to retrieve Z2. While it failed to defeat their Pokémon the first time it succeeded the second time and managed to corner Z2. It, however, was blown back once more when Z2 transformed to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|50% Forme}}. After Z2 was brought down, Druddigon and Weavile were used to blast Team Rocket off. Druddigon reappeared in ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', during [[Team Flare]]'s takeover of [[Lumiose City]], where it attacked [[Ash's friends]] to stop them from entering [[Prism Tower]]. In [[XY133|the next episode]], it battled the group's Pokémon alongside [[Bryony]]'s {{p|Liepard}}, but it was eventually defeated. Druddigon's known moves are {{m|Dragon Pulse}}, {{m|Slash}}, {{m|Dark Pulse}}, and {{m|Dragon Claw}}.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color=eb8b51|bordercolor=ab3f26 |ja=夏日凜子 ''[[Rinko Natsuhi]]'' |en=[[Theresa Buchheister]] |it=Ludovica De Caro |pl=Julia Kołakowska-Bytner |es_eu=Inés Blázquez |es_la=Alicia Barragán}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Team Flare Scientists Adventures.png|thumb|right|270px|Aliana in Pokémon Adventures]] Aliana debuted in ''[[PS550|X-actly What They Wanted]]''. She, [[Mable]], and a group of {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s traveled to [[Vaniville Town]] to steal {{adv|X}}'s [[Mega Ring]]. While protecting her {{pkmn|Trainer}} from the two scientists, X's [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]] was injured. This angered Kanga's baby, Li'l Kanga, who reacted to the Mega Ring and [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] into Mega Kangaskhan and easily drove the villains off. In ''[[PS551|Inn-teresting Developments]]'', X's friends stayed at an [[Aquacorde Town]] inn while he slept in the tent on {{adv|Y}}'s {{p|Rhyhorn}}'s back. The inn was a trap designed to keep Y and the others inside while Aliana and Mable tried to steal Li'l Kanga when X wasn't looking. Y broke out and informed X of the situation, but when he tried to Mega Evolve Li'l Kanga again, it failed. With no other options, X and Y teamed up with [[Marisso|Chespin]] and [[Croaky|Froakie]] to defeat the scientists. X had Chespin pin Aliana and Mable to a tree with {{m|Pin Missile}}, preventing them from chasing the Vaniville children as they fled to a nearby forest. In ''[[PS555|The Aegislash Agenda]]'', Aliana and Mable met with [[Bryony]] and [[Xerosic]] at the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]]. They were informed that their repeat failures have led to [[Celosia]] taking over their duties. In ''[[PS578|Gyarados Changes]]'', Aliana and the other female scientists witnessed X trying to break into the Secret HQ. Noting Celosia hadn't slept since she brought [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] back to base, Aliana and Mable offered to stop X in her place, only for Bryony to tell them to return to their stations. Later, after the [[ultimate weapon]] was stopped by X and his friends, Aliana and Mable helped Bryony up after she was defeated by Y and her newly caught Xerxer. In ''[[PS589|Charizard Transforms]]'', Aliana and the other female scientists each intercepted Y and her friends to prevent them from reaching the [[Pokémon Village]]. Aliana picked Y as her opponent, but their battle was interrupted when Y left to go help her friends fight {{p|Yveltal}}. When Y came back to assist {{adv|Tierno}} and {{adv|Shauna}} with {{adv|Trevor}}, they were ambushed by Aliana and Bryony. Trevor decided to stay behind to fight by himself and told Y to go to the village and help X. Later, after Trevor managed to take down Bryony, Aliana attempted a sneak attack, only to be ambushed by Tierno and Shauna, forcing her to give up. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Aliana |pkmn=Diggersby |type1=Normal |type2=Ground |gender=female |img=Aliana Diggersby Adventures.png |epnum=PS551 |epname=Inn-teresting Developments |desc={{p|Diggersby}} is Aliana's first known Pokémon. She was first used to kidnap {{adv|X}}'s [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] in [[Aquacorde Town]], but was defeated by X's [[Marisso|Chespin]]. Later, near the [[Pokémon Village]], she was used to lure {{adv|Y}} and {{adv|Trevor}} into a trap, but was taken out by Trevor's {{p|Flabébé}}. Diggersby's known moves are {{m|Mud Shot}} and {{m|Rototiller}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Aliana |pkmn=Pumpkaboo |type1=Ghost |type2=Grass |img=Aliana Pumpkaboo Adventures.png |epnum=PS591 |epname=Mewtwo Angered |desc={{p|Pumpkaboo}} is Aliana's second known Pokémon. It was first used to attack {{adv|Y}} and {{adv|Trevor}} near the [[Pokémon Village]]. Pumpkaboo's only known move is {{m|Seed Bomb}}.}} =====Borrowed===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Aliana |pkmn=Pyroar |gender=female |type1=Fire |type2=Normal |img=Aliana Pyroar Adventures.png |img_size=150px |epnum=PS550 |epname=X-actly What They Wanted |desc={{p|Pyroar}} was used to attack {{adv|X}}'s house in order to steal his [[Mega Ring]]. She defeated [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]], X's {{p|Kangaskhan}}, but was defeated by X's baby Kangaskhan, Li'l Kanga, after she [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] into Mega Kangaskhan. Later, it was revealed that Pyroar belonged to [[Malva]], who took her back after returning to active duty.
